user.title: STB Bucuresti
user.description:
This integration provides real-time tracking of public transport vehicles (trams, buses, trolleybuses) in Bucharest, Romania.

Click Submit to connect to the STB API and select the lines you want to monitor.

select_lines.title: Select Transport Lines
select_lines.description: Select the transport lines you want to monitor. Each line will create sensors for vehicle tracking.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to STB API. Please try again later.
error.no_lines: No transport lines found. Please try again later.
error.no_lines_selected: Please select at least one transport line.
